name: terminal-normal-reset-disable
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 delay=1.8n period=4.7n width=2.1n rise=80p fall=80p
Vreset (reset 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.9 4.37n 0.9 4.57n 0 58.37n 0 58.57n 0.9 63.37n 0.9 63.57n 0 110.37n 0]
Venable (enable 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 5.37n 0 5.57n 0.9 31.37n 0.9 31.57n 0 41.37n 0 41.57n 0.9 110.37n 0.9]
Vinp (vinp 0) vsource type=sine sinedc=0.37 ampl=0.27 freq=23Meg
Vinn (vinn 0) vsource type=sine sinedc=0.46 ampl=0.12 freq=19Meg
XDUT (vinp vinn clk reset enable rms_out valid) sampled_true_rms_to_dc tr=80p

tran tran stop=110n maxstep=40p
save vinp vinn clk reset enable rms_out valid
